KvStore.doc: A string-to-string map shared by every member of the context.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: Every stored value by key; concurrent writes to one key keep the latest.

methods.name: clear
methods.doc:
Removes every key.

Emits `Cleared` only when the store was not already empty.

methods.name: entries
methods.doc: Returns every key with its value, as a JSON object ordered by key.
methods.returns_doc:
A JSON object mapping every key to its value, ordered by key; `{}` when the
store is empty.

methods.name: get
methods.doc:
Returns the value under `key`, or `null` when the key is absent.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting"}
```
methods.returns_doc: The value stored under `key`, or `null` when `key` is absent.

methods.name: get_or_insert
methods.doc:
Returns the value under `key`, first storing `value` there if the key is
absent.

An existing value is returned unchanged and `value` is ignored. Emits
`Inserted` only when the key was absent.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting", "value": "hello"}
```

params.name: key
params.doc: The key to read, or to create when absent.

params.name: value
params.doc: The value to store when `key` is absent.

methods.returns_doc:
The value `key` holds after the call: the existing value when `key` was
present, otherwise `value`.

methods.name: get_result
methods.doc:
Returns the value under `key`, failing with a typed error when it is absent.

# Errors

Fails with `{"kind": "NotFound", "data": "<key>"}` when `key` is absent.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting"}
```

methods.name: get_unchecked
methods.doc:
Returns the value under `key`, aborting the call when the key is absent.

Kept to show what a guest panic looks like; use `get` or `get_result`.

# Errors

Fails with a guest panic (`key not found`) when `key` is absent.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting"}
```

params.name: key
params.doc: The key to read. It must exist.

methods.name: init
methods.doc:
Creates the empty store. The node runs it once, when the context is created.

# Errors

Fails with `Cannot initialize over already existing state.` when the
context already has a store.

methods.name: len
methods.doc: Returns the number of keys in the store.
methods.returns_doc: The number of keys in the store; `0` when it is empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.doc:
Removes `key` and returns the value it held, or `null` when it was absent.

Emits `Removed` only when a value was actually removed.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting"}
```
methods.returns_doc: The value `key` held before the call, or `null` when `key` was absent.

methods.name: set
methods.doc:
Stores `value` under `key`, replacing any value already there.

Emits `Inserted` for a new key and `Updated` for an existing one.
Concurrent writes to the same key from different members converge to the
latest write.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting", "value": "hello"}
```

params.name: key
params.doc: The key to write. Any string, including the empty string.

methods.name: update_if_exists
methods.doc:
Replaces the value under `key` only if the key already exists, and returns
whether it did.

Emits `Updated` when the value is replaced.

# Examples

```json
{"key": "greeting", "value": "hi"}
```

params.name: key
params.doc: The key to update. It must already exist for anything to change.

methods.returns_doc:
`true` when `key` existed and now holds `value`; `false` when `key` was
absent, in which case nothing was written.

events.name: Cleared
events.doc: Every key was removed from a non-empty store.

events.name: Removed
events.doc: A key and its value were removed.

events.name: Updated
events.doc: An existing key's value was replaced.
